title: Characterisations of Kullback--Leibler approximation by finite Gaussian mixtures
summary: We study the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence approximation theory of Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) by isolating an abstract mechanism behind several necessary-and-sufficient statements. The necessity direction is universal: if a density is approximable in KL divergence by finite GMMs, then it must have finite second moment. The sufficient direction is reduced to the construction of approximating GMMs whose likelihood ratios converge pointwise and whose finite log-ratios form a uniformly integrable family.
